persons.name: Cikadhigubhājana
persons.evidence: likhitaṃ mānadevasasakārita cakramavihārāvasthita śrīvajrācāryya (cika)dhigu bhājana coyāgu julo

relations.evidence: surendra vikramasāhasya vijayarāje || || likhitaṃ mānadevasasakārita cakramavihārāvasthita śrīvajrācāryya (cika)dhigu bhājana coyāgu julo

date.as_written: saṃmvata 979 miti kārttikaśuklayā paṃcami, pūrvāṣāḍhāna[kṣa]tra, dhṛtiyoga budhavāra

purpose: dhanajanasaṃntā thila juyamāla, kṛvikṛyavāniryya vyapāla sāphalya juyamāla, dasākuśalapāpamocana juyamāla
notes: Mānadeva is mentioned as the legendary/historical founder of Cakramahāvihāra (mānadevasaṃskārita), not a contemporary person. The scribe's name may be interpreted as Bhājana with the Newari adjective cikādhigu ('younger/small').
